Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Three new themes.** **Look → Themes** has three more ready-made looks: **Moonlit** (floating words under the Moonlight sky), **Drift** (a flowing line of words in the album's colour) and **Corona** (warm words under the eclipse). One click sets them up, and you can still change anything afterwards.
- **Keep the whole line.** With the **World** layout, a line's words now stay up together until the line is over, then fade away together, so you can read the whole line at once. Turn **Keep the whole line** off in **Lyrics → Position** to go back to words fading as soon as the next ones come.
- **Sky tint.** With the **World** layout, the floating words take on a little of the sky's colour, as if the sky lights them. Turn **Sky tint** off in **Lyrics → Position** to keep your own colour exactly.

### Better looking

- **No more words piled on top of each other.** When a lot of words are floating at once, they spread out a little wider instead of landing on each other.
- **Gentler goodbyes.** When there are more floating words than **Words at once** allows, the oldest one now fades away instead of disappearing all at once.
